title: Patient Payment Plan Agreement, Schedule A: Term, Installment, Down Payment and Signing
content:
Schedule A sets out, tier by tier, the repayment figures of a Patient Payment Plan agreement: the number of monthly installments after any down payment, the smallest monthly installment allowed, the down payment terms, the annual interest rate, the signature window and the installment due day.

## A.1 Term, installment and interest

| Tier | Monthly installments after the down payment | Smallest monthly installment (USD) | Annual interest on the plan balance |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 3 | 25.00 | 0 percent |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 6 | 40.00 | 0 percent |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 75.00 | 0 percent |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 12 | 125.00 | 0 percent |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 18 | 140.00 | 0 percent |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 24 | 20.00 | 0 percent |

## A.2 Down payment

| Tier | Down payment, percent of the enrolled balance | Smallest down payment where one is required (USD) | Down payment taken at signing |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 0 (none required) | 0.00 | Yes |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 25.00 | Yes |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 75.00 | Yes |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 15 | 225.00 | Yes |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 15 | 375.00 | Yes |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 0 (none required) | 0.00 | No |

## A.3 Signing and due day

| Tier | Signature window (calendar days after enrollment) | First installment falls at least this many calendar days after signing | Due days of the month the patient may choose |
|---|---|---|---|
| Short-Term 3-Month Payment Plan | 7 | 30 | 1 or 15 |
| Standard 6-Month Payment Plan | 7 | 30 | 1 or 15 |
| Extended 10-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 30 | 1 or 15 |
| Long-Term 12-Month Payment Plan | 10 | 30 | 1 or 15 |
| Large-Balance 18-Month Payment Plan | 14 | 30 | 1 or 15 |
| Hardship 24-Month Payment Plan | 14 | 30 | 1 or 15 |

## Notes to Schedule A

- No tier of the Patient Payment Plan charges interest: the annual rate is 0 percent throughout.
- The two tiers with a down payment percentage of 0 carry a smallest down payment of 0.00; they require no down payment.
- Every tier offers the same two due days, the 1st and the 15th of the month, and the same 30-day lead to the first installment.
